claims.text: Aggressive B-cell lymphoma (eg, DLBCL): strd = R-CHOP (rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, prednisone).
claims.quote: In patients with aggressive B-cell lymphomas (eg, diffuse large B cell), the standard combination is rituximab plus cyclophosphamide, hydroxydaunorubicin (doxorubicin), vincristine, and prednisone (R-CHOP)

claims.text: Polatuzumab vedotin may replace vincristine in R-CHOP.
claims.quote: Patients may benefit from adding the antibody-drug conjugate polatuzumab vedotin, a CD79b-directed antibody-drug conjugate to R-CHOP as a substitute for vincristine

claims.text: Polivy + R-CHP: untx DLBCL or HGBL w an International Prognostic Index score of 2 or greater.
claims.quote: in combination with a rituximab product, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, and prednisone (R-CHP) for the treatment of adult patients who have previously untreated diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), not otherwise specified (NOS) or high-grade B-cell lymphoma (HGBL) and who have an International Prognostic Index score of 2 or greater
